              <span>تصفية</span>
              {(selectedEmployee || selectedJobDepartment || selectedJobTitle || selectedCustomer || selectedCategory || selectedWarehouse || selectedStatus || (dateFrom && !isDefaultDate) || dateTo || filterOrderNumber || filterCreatedBy) && (
                <span className="bg-white text-primary rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[0.7rem] font-bold mr-1">نشط</span>
              )}
            </button>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button 
                className="bg-white shadow-sm hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer" 
                title="طباعة"
                onClick={handlePrint}
                style={{ width: '54px', height: '38px', border: '2px solid #3b82f6', padding: '0', color: '#3b82f6' }}
              >
                <Printer size={22} strokeWidth={2.5} />
              </button>
              <button 
                className="bg-white shadow-sm hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer" 
                title="تصدير إلى Word"
                onClick={() => openPrintConfig('word')}
                style={{ width: '54px', height: '38px', border: '2px solid #3b82f6', padding: '0' }}
              >
                <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Word" style={{ width: '28px', height: '28px' }} />
              </button>
              <button 
                className="bg-white shadow-sm hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer" 
                title="تصدير إلى Excel"
                onClick={() => openPrintConfig('excel')}
                style={{ width: '54px', height: '38px', border: '2px solid #3b82f6', padding: '0' }}
              >
                <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="Excel" style={{ width: '28px', height: '28px' }} />
              </button>
              <button 
                className="bg-white shadow-sm hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer" 
                title="تصدير إلى PDF"
                onClick={() => openPrintConfig('pdf')}
                style={{ width: '54px', height: '38px', border: '2px solid #3b82f6', padding: '0' }}
              >
                <img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," alt="PDF" style={{ width: '28px', height: '28px' }} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
